data.jobspec:
#!/bin/bash

#SBATCH --job-name="Moons (ECCCo)"
#SBATCH --time=01:30:00
#SBATCH --ntasks=30
#SBATCH --cpus-per-task=10
#SBATCH --partition=compute
#SBATCH --mem-per-cpu=2GB
#SBATCH --account=research-eemcs-insy
#SBATCH --mail-type=END

module load 2023r1 openmpi

source experiments/slurm_header.sh

srun julia --project=experiments --threads $SLURM_CPUS_PER_TASK experiments/run_experiments.jl -- data=moons output_path=results mpi threaded n_individuals=100 n_runs=50 > experiments/logs/moons.log

issues: The job name 'Moons (ECCCo)' contains spaces and parentheses. While Slurm handles this correctly when quoted, simpler names without special characters are often more robust and less prone to parsing issues in scripts or monitoring tools.

Standard error is not explicitly redirected to the specified log file. This will cause error messages to appear in the default Slurm output file (`slurm-<jobid>.out`) instead of `experiments/logs/moons.log`. For consolidated logging, consider using `... > experiments/logs/moons.log 2>&1`.

The script assumes the log directory `experiments/logs/` exists. The job will fail if this directory is not present before execution. It is safer to add `mkdir -p experiments/logs` before the `srun` command.

The job sources an external script `experiments/slurm_header.sh`. The behavior of the job is dependent on the contents of this file, which was not provided for validation and could be a source of errors.
